# ForCoTech (Silent Engineering di Romolo Vicari)

> ForCoTech and Silent-Mode (VAT IT03833150133) are the acoustic enclosure brands of Silent Engineering di Romolo Vicari, Via Trento 22, 23875 Osnago (LC), Italy. We design and supply acoustic enclosures (Schallhauben) for heat pumps and large heat pumps, chillers, dry coolers, VRF/VRV outdoor units and PV inverters, engineered with CFD, BIM and noise calculation, built with Absora technology (HSA3 inner lining, non-combustible A1). Contact: info@forcotech.com

## Configurator and catalogues
- [Schallhauben-Konfigurator](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/): enter unit dimensions, refrigerant (incl. R290), air flow, acoustics (TA Lärm) and wind zone; returns outer dimensions, noise reduction and a budget price
- [Standard enclosures VRF/VRV](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/vrf/): models from Daikin, Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic, LG, Samsung, Toshiba, Haier with dimensions and prices (Standard approx. −15 dB(A), Premium approx. −20 dB(A))
- [Enclosures for PV inverters](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/pv/): wall-mounted and free-standing versions for 1–5 inverters (Huawei, Sungrow, SMA, Fronius, SolarEdge and others) with prices
- [Large equipment catalogue](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/grossanlagen/): enclosures for large heat pumps, chillers and commercial refrigeration by manufacturer and model
- English versions: [configurator](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/en/), [VRF](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/en/vrf/), [PV](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/en/pv/), [large equipment](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/en/grossanlagen/)
- French versions: [configurateur](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/fr/), [VRF](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/fr/vrf/), [PV](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/fr/pv/), [grandes installations](https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/fr/grossanlagen/)

## Key facts
- Noise reduction: approx. −15 dB(A) Standard, approx. −20 dB(A) Premium, higher on a project basis
- Prices (net, excl. installation, VAT, freight): PV inverter enclosures from approx. €4,400, VRF/VRV standard enclosures from approx. €15,500
- HSA3 acoustic meta-metal by ABSORA GmbH (Berlin, patent holder): up to 40 % lower pressure drop than conventional splitter silencers, reverberation room tested to EN ISO 354 (TU Berlin 2026): fibre-free up to 0.80, with 100 mm mineral wool backing 0.83 already at 100 Hz; alternative lining Stratocell Whisper 50 mm FR
- How HSA3 works: micro-perforated, corrugated metal top layer on a spring-mounted structure; air chambers act as resonators (Helmholtz and mass-spring principle), no mineral wool; effective at low compressor frequencies
- HSA3 as a modular kit: compressor panels, retrofit fan cylinders against blade passing frequency, partition walls between heat pumps (also keep defrost air off the neighbouring unit), full enclosures; bolted aluminium profile system 45 x 45 mm, liftable without a crane
- Design targets: 5–7 m/s in free openings, max. 3–5 % loss of unit capacity
- Product lines: H series (small heat pumps), CM series (large heat pumps/chillers), V series (VRF/VRV), Wall series (noise barriers), PV inverter and BESS enclosures
- In alliance with ABSORA GmbH, Berlin (developer and patent holder of HSA3): design by Silent Engineering, manufacturing and installation together with ABSORA
- R290 (propane) units: enclosure only with written manufacturer approval; floorless design so leaked propane flows away, no ignition sources (except explosion-proof), permanently open storm/relief openings on at least two sides, relief areas to EN 14994 if a zone lies inside, CFD check of gas outflow
- 500+ enclosure projects since 2015; first projects 2015 in the UK; installations across Europe, smaller numbers in the USA and Australia

## SilentMode H-Series (small units)
- [H-Serie (Deutsch)](https://www.forcotech.com/h-serie/) · [H-Series (English)](https://www.forcotech.com/en/h-series/): acoustic enclosures H1–H12 for heat pumps and air-conditioning units in residential buildings (for installers, contractors and property managers), noise reduction levels −10/−18/−25 dB(A), also custom-made; configurator https://www.forcotech.com/konfigurator/h-serie/

## Solutions by application
- [Lösungen (Deutsch)](https://www.forcotech.com/loesungen/) · [Solutions (English)](https://www.forcotech.com/en/solutions/): overview and quick selection, each linked to the matching configurator section
- Heat pumps and AC in residential buildings, H-Series: [DE](https://www.forcotech.com/loesungen/waermepumpen-klimaanlagen/) · [EN](https://www.forcotech.com/en/solutions/heat-pumps-air-conditioning/) – TA Lärm night limits, worked example, −10/−18/−25 dB(A), max. 4 m/s
- VRF/VRV outdoor units, V-Series: [DE](https://www.forcotech.com/loesungen/vrf-vrv/) · [EN](https://www.forcotech.com/en/solutions/vrf-vrv/) – standard enclosure per model for Daikin, Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic, LG, Samsung, Toshiba, Haier; module combinations up to 4; base frame by others
- Chillers and large heat pumps, CM-Series: [DE](https://www.forcotech.com/loesungen/chiller-grosswaermepumpen/) · [EN](https://www.forcotech.com/en/solutions/chillers-large-heat-pumps/) – tube silencers Ø 200 mm, separate air paths, targets 5–7 m/s and max. 3–5 % capacity loss, catalogue of 19 manufacturers
- PV inverters and battery storage (BESS): [DE](https://www.forcotech.com/loesungen/wechselrichter-bess/) · [EN](https://www.forcotech.com/en/solutions/inverters-bess/) – wall-mounted and free-standing for 1–5 inverters from approx. €4,400 net, BESS per project
- Noise barriers, Wall-Series: [DE](https://www.forcotech.com/loesungen/schallwaende/) · [EN](https://www.forcotech.com/en/solutions/noise-barriers/) – barrier vs. enclosure, typically 6–10 dB(A), screening to ISO 9613-2
- [HSA3 (Deutsch)](https://www.forcotech.com/hsa3/) · [HSA3 (English)](https://www.forcotech.com/en/hsa3/): structure, working principle (Helmholtz resonators, mass-spring system, impedance step), key data and evidence, reverberation room test results to EN ISO 354 (TU Berlin, Feb 2026: HSA3 with 100 mm mineral wool NRC 0.85 / class C, HSA3 (0.1) alpha 0.83 at 100 Hz, fibre-free HSA3 NRC 0.60–0.65; test report PDF https://www.forcotech.com/downloads/absora-hsa3-hallraum-absorptionsgrade-2026.pdf), comparison with mineral wool and foam
